This page presents the open sequence from the concise root `plan.md`; blocked decisions and milestone history remain in that source roadmap. The separate [AWS Alert Execution Plan](aws-alert-execution-plan.qmd) is a review-only alternative, not part of the current ordered Azure sequence.

## Azure-First Cloud-Portable Readiness Milestone

This cross-cutting Azure-first milestone is nonproduction and non-sending. Discovery may run alongside Open Sequence items 1–6; provision only after inventory approvals and an IaC decision. It coordinates Cloud Plan gates 1–3, the existing Stage A proof (item 7), measured nonproduction component work, and a separately approved subscription-service nonproduction lane. Registry production launch stays after shadow and its own service gate; this grants no public production, publication, recipient collection, sending, or AWS.
See the [root plan](https://github.com/ewheeler/aots/blob/main/plan.md#azure-first-cloud-portable-deployment-readiness-milestone) for detailed before/during/exit evidence and deferrals, and the [Cloud Deployment Plan](cloud-deployment-plan.qmd), [Azure Alert Execution Plan](azure-alert-execution-plan.qmd), [Alert Subscription Service Plan](alert-subscription-service-plan.qmd), and [Observability Assessment](observability-assessment.qmd) for canonical criteria.

## Open Sequence

1. Implement deterministic Storm Episode and link-event runtime while preserving existing V1 behavior; keep episode-dependent operations disabled until identity stability evidence is approved.
2. Add ProductDecision v2 and complete ProductFactSet v2 production for official Warning/Alert and forecast-only Warning, with fail-closed review outcomes.
3. Add the one-way supported V1 adapter and a checksummed cross-repository ProductFactSet artifact handshake.
4. Add strict root loading and validation without duplicating Orchestration classification policy.
5. Compose the compatibility product from the closed PresentationProfile and prove semantic claim parity against independent frozen V1 claims.
6. Integrate CompositionManifest and PublicationManifest v2, including actual HTML/PNG privacy inspection and source approval enforcement.
7. Exercise the implemented non-normative [Alert Packaging Consultation Pack](alert-packaging-consultation.qmd) as the synthetic-only Stage A proof in the Azure readiness milestone, through the manual job with no Snowflake, registry/recipient, queue, provider, or delivery-ledger access.
8. Complete accountable consultation for official Alert, official Warning, and forecast-only Warning packaging, then record an accepted decision before adding concise email or technical-report profiles.
9. Add typed official warning-zone, rainfall, and surge facts only after source licensing, supported semantics, and manual-review behavior are approved; exclude unapproved hazard expansions from any shadow cohort that does not satisfy those gates.
10. Add independently versioned content and lifecycle-policy releases only after their corresponding consultation and policy decisions, before activating dependent behavior. This does not block Storm Episode/link-event persistence or Stage B source-checkpoint/comparison state.
11. Run a non-sending multi-Country-Office shadow pilot over finalized source-ready manifests, V2 policy/composition, historical replay, and independent expected evidence for an approved cohort.
12. Launch the Entra-authenticated subscription registry independently, after shadow and its own service gate, with no queue, provider, or send path.
13. Approve Delivery Authorization, Azure SQL delivery state, outbox/inbox, Service Bus, resolver, provider feedback, suppression, reconciliation, and cutover contracts before a controlled live-send pilot.
14. Expand through measured Country Office/product rings and SLO/residency-driven regional cells only after live-pilot and recovery gates pass.

Current work through registration and the shadow pilot remains non-sending. The later controlled-send and global stages stay blocked until their explicit [Activation And Publication Gates](publication-gates.qmd) pass. A consultation pack, screenshot, pull-request approval, or accessibility scan is review evidence rather than profile, publication, or activation approval.
